final_sql:
SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.Street,
    s.City,
    s.Zip,
    s.State
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE 
    f.`School Type` = 'High Schools (Public)'
    AND s.County = 'Monterey'
    AND f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800;
